items.title: Joseph Thomas Interview, 1960-09-29
items.q: So they pass through here going to Corn Eye and Johnson or Corn Eye and Nero.

ctx.x: What time was the best time?

Well, they get dressed early. You see them getting together around 8 o'clock in the morning. Oh, yes. 8 o'clock in the morning. Some of them pass here going up there. You know, they live all over the city. So they pass through here going to Corn Eye and Johnson or Corn Eye and Nero. Either one of them.
I'll go around there next morning.
